language_reason: The README's extension path is the Python API (`gpc.training.train`, `gpc.policy.Policy` save/load/apply, environments in `gpc.envs`). The example scripts (`examples/<task>.py train|test|sample`) take no parameters, hard-code /tmp save paths, and their `test` mode opens an interactive MuJoCo viewer (`gpc/testing.py` uses mujoco.viewer.launch_passive), so tools must call the library rather than the scripts.
gpu_reason: pyproject pins jax[cuda12]==0.4.35 and mujoco-mjx 3.2.4; JAX also runs on CPU, so a GPU is optional, but the paper trains on an RTX 4070 and CPU training of the larger tasks is slow. Device use is checked by the environment manager.
requested_filter: Simulation training/evaluation of the shipped example tasks; interactive viewer functions are out of scope (no display).
unresolved_prerequisites: hydrax is installed from git tag v0.0.1 (https://github.com/vincekurtz/hydrax); jax[cuda12] wheels must match the installed NVIDIA driver (the DIAL-MPC environment in this workspace hit a cuBLAS/cuSOLVER wheel mismatch).
All JAX/MuJoCo imports are heavy jobs and are disabled in this workspace until the user's memory decision (mcp-build/HEAVY_JOBS_DISABLED).
